classification: Bounded visible isolated Electron comparison, synthetic real HTMLAudioElement PCM and actual local owner/publisher/Hub/WS/Focus path. Natural model replay is separate.

sameCase.afterOnlyFixtureDifference: Fine units share old coarse starts and source ranges, each ends start+350ms; 150ms gap. Before retains starts-only.
sameCase.cold: Fresh Electron process, isolated unique profile and newly loaded Output document; OS/font/disk cache is not globally cleared.
sameCase.warm: Same Electron/Output document first plays the identical source until 1.2s to prime fonts and line-fit, then pauses/seeks0 and clears only observation arrays before the original full playback protocol. Offset content change can legitimately remeasure.
sameCase.excludedIntermediate: results/after/cold-* and warm-* plus after-runtime are retained invisible-pseudo intermediate; diagnostic reports are excluded from timing.

firstGlyphTraceDiagnostic.classification: One cold trace-only first-glyph diagnostic per cohort. Original 3+3 untraced distributions remain unchanged; no warm trace and no causal population inference.
firstGlyphTraceDiagnostic.interpretation: This pair observed higher fine measurement/render/commit wall work and a later next rAF observation. Both are measured components; n=1, different timer versus publication entry and trace overhead prevent attribution of the original cold or warm median increase to either component alone.
limitations: Trace overhead affects scheduling and is not subtracted from or substituted for performance results.
The first commit is an instrumented DOM commit completion, not proof of hardware presentation or audible onset.
Signed media at commit/observation uses adjacent genuine local HTMLAudioElement rAF samples, so interpolation/frame quantization remains bounded by the recorded brackets.
Chrome style/layout events nest and must not be added together as independent costs.

fixturePairVerification.pcmGenerationSame: One unchanged wav() implementation generates 24s 16kHz 16-bit mono silent PCM for every variant, with no variant branch.

signConvention: Positive late, negative early; media milliseconds and rate-adjusted wall milliseconds are reported separately

functional.classification: Visible real HTMLAudioElement diagnostics, separate from performance samples. CSS variable and computed pseudo-element clip are both observed. AX content alternative and pixel screenshots are supporting browser-specific evidence.
limitations: Focus does not render reading/ruby by its existing template design; ruby functional coverage is local.
rAF observations and captures add diagnostic workload and cannot be used as untraced performance samples.
Capacity is a bounded 20-glyph, 9-glyph-wide 3-row case, including four five-glyph model units; no arbitrary-script guarantee.
Natural source/model evidence is separate from synthetic silent-PCM paint/clock checks.
Skipped spans remain absent; no clamping or interpolation fills gaps. Partial fine units are allowed by contract.
Original occurrence word ranges are authoritative; phoneme starts/ends do not create extra kanji boundaries.
Existing dataset has four CJK clips and no successful new English inference; it does not establish general language coverage.
Three runs per warmth/variant are a bounded diagnostic sample, not a population-wide performance guarantee.
No hardware audio output, OBS, original lyrics/model accuracy or arbitrary-template claim.
Known onsets, PCM definition and control sequence are unchanged; frame/sample counts and control phase endpoints vary naturally.
Seek-discontinuity cross-window interpolation can produce ambiguous control-boundary signed values; these remain in original control windows and are separate from steady onset distributions.
